claim_text: We use this ‘safety guarantee’ to instil a belief that everyone can go home safe and well.
metric_name: Fatalities from health and safety incidents
context_text: We use this ‘safety guarantee’ to instil a belief that everyone can go home safe and well.；Tragically, we experienced a fatality within our business this year.；Health and safety performance FY25: Fatalities from health and safety incidents 1.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: 报告同页及相邻页明确披露FY25发生1起致命事故，与“everyone can go home safe and well”这一结果性、绝对化表述直接冲突。
notes: 典型安全类绝对化宣传语。
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that the company uses a “safety guarantee” to instil a belief that everyone can go home safe and well (i.e., an effective safety culture/outcome). The only provided evidence is the metric “Fatalities from health and safety incidents” with an extracted value of 1 fatality. This does not substantively verify that the “safety guarantee” instils the stated belief or that everyone can go home safe and well; it provides no information about the guarantee, its implementation, or outcomes beyond reporting a fatality count. The presence of 1 fatality also weakens any implied universal safety outcome (“everyone”).
